ledger.note: 1910: the Union of South Africa is founded on 31 May. 'It came into existence on 31 May 1910 with the unification of the' Cape, Natal, Transvaal and Orange River colonies; Walvis Bay joined as an exclave of the Cape.

1915: South Africa captures German South West Africa. 'In 1915, during the South West Africa campaign of World War I, South Africa captured the German colony.' (Union page: 'occupied in 1915'.) The page does not give the surrender date.

1920: South West Africa becomes a League of Nations mandate under South Africa. The SWA page says only that the League made it a Class C mandate in 'the 1920s' and gives no date; the year is bridging.

1920: South Africa holds South West Africa as a Class C mandate, 'administered as 5th province of the Union' (Union page); Walvis Bay was administered with it from 1922 under the South West Africa Affairs Act (Walvis Bay page).

1961: the Union becomes the Republic of South Africa on 31 May. 'The Republic of South Africa was established on 31 May 1961 after the passage of the constitution' (whites-only referendum of 5 October 1960).

1966: the UN declares South Africa's mandate over South West Africa ended. 'On 27 October 1966, the General Assembly passed resolution 2145 (XXI) which declared the Mandate terminated.' South African control continued; the ICJ held it illegal in 1971.
1976: Transkei is declared independent on 26 October. 'with effect from 26 October 1976' (Status of Transkei Act 100 of 1976); only South Africa recognised it.
1977: Bophuthatswana is declared independent on 6 December. 'with effect from 6 December 1977' (Status of Bophuthatswana Act 89 of 1977).
1979: Venda is declared independent on 13 September. 'with effect from 13 September 1979' (Status of Venda Act 107 of 1979).
1981: Ciskei is declared independent on 4 December. 'with effect from 4 December 1981' (Status of Ciskei Act 110 of 1981).
1990: Namibia becomes independent on 21 March; South Africa's occupation ends.

notes: Cliopatria's South Africa row begins in 1932, but the state was founded as the Union of South Africa on 31 May 1910, so the dossier starts in 1910 with two new keyframes (1910-1914 the Union; 1915-1931 the Union plus South West Africa). The af-07 dossiers (british-cape-colony, colony-of-natal, transvaal-colony, orange-river-colony) name the successor 'union-of-south-africa', a slug with no dossier: it is this dossier, slug south-africa, and the references need re-pointing. The british-africa dossier (af-08-b) draws the Union as British Africa until a loss event of December 1931 to south-africa; because this dossier draws it from 1910, that loss should be dated 31 May 1910 (and British Africa's 1910-1931 keyframes cut) or the two dossiers will overlap for 21 years. South West Africa 1915-1932 is drawn as occupation then mandate (1920 at confidence 1: page silent); the cells of 'german-africa' and 'british-africa' that cover it before 1932 need the same cut. The bantustan counterparts transkei, bophuthatswana, venda and ciskei have no dossier and need one (group af-08-x or a gap-filler); the gazetteer lacks the regions Transkei, Bophuthatswana, Venda and Ciskei. The Namibian war of independence (SWAPO from 1960, South African Border War) was not on the pages opened and is not dated here; the Prince Edward Islands and the Basutoland/Bechuanaland/Swaziland protectorates (not mentioned on the Union page) are not covered. The Cliopatria 1973 shape has a stray bounding-box vertex at 55.4E, -4.6N that fills no cell.
